seo_titulo: Trovadoras: interviews with the women of Cuban song
seo_desc: Trovadoras (Editorial Oriente, 2008), interviews with the women of the Cuban trova, with Isabel Moya on gender and Lino Betancourt on music.
cubierta_alt: Cover of Trovadoras, illustrated by Ramón Eduardo Haití

galeria.pie: Launch of Trovadoras. Photos: Ramón Eduardo Haití and Alain Gutiérrez Almeida

galeria.alt: Presentation of Trovadoras at the Havana International Book Fair

catalogo.sinopsis: Interviews and guitars again, this time in women's voices alone. With Dr Isabel Moya Richard and the musicographer Lino Betancourt, gender studies and the history of the trova bring their expertise to these pages.
